notes: V0.3.1 failed because raw price-core accuracy did not beat a naive always-UP benchmark and balanced accuracy was near random.
V0.3.2 debiases analog voting with an inverse-square-root independent-episode class prior and similarity weighting.
V0.3.2 acceptance is based on one predeclared walk-forward anchor per point-in-time test episode, not overlapping monthly rows.
Balanced accuracy, both class recalls, prediction mix, coverage, and a naive training-majority benchmark are mandatory.
An ABSTAIN state is allowed when adjusted UP/DOWN support is too close.
On-chain and macro no longer search the full history independently for confirmation; they rerank only a price-similar independent-episode pool.
On-chain/macro remain confirmation or contradiction evidence only and cannot change the price-core direction.
No future data may be used in feature construction, episode assignment, class priors, or analog outcomes.
N/A is excluded and weights are renormalized; N/A is never zero-filled.
MVRVZ_DERIVED_PIT is a point-in-time derived proxy, not a vendor-reported official MVRV Z-Score.
Derivatives and ETF Layer B/C remain blocked until V0.3.2 passes its locked gates.
MASTER BTC TREND scoring, entry gates, schedule, and live plan remain untouched.
